findings.title: Potential cross-business leak in newMfrMap query
findings.description: The date-filtered new_mfr_quantity is calculated without business scope filtering; confirm whether manufacturing staff can accidentally see production from other businesses via this field.

findings.title: No business filter in newMfrMap query
findings.description: The newMfrMap query does not include a business_id WHERE clause, while the main productionOutputs query does. The risk is mitigated by keying (product_id + branch_id only includes values from the business-restricted main query), but this is implicit coupling rather than explicit filtering. Future changes could expose a vulnerability.
